Nokia Oyj Sponsored ADR Rejoins Euro Stoxx 50
: NOKIA shares rose ~1.7% after STOXX said Nokia will rejoin the Euro STOXX 50, replacing Volkswagen — traders should note the index inclusion and the immediate price reaction.

: Nokia (NOKIA) opened an R&D center in Riyadh to develop AI-driven network automation (SMO, SON, Autopilot, rApps), train local talent, explore 6G and deliver Saudi-made software for global customers.
: JPMorgan keeps Overweight on Nokia (NOKIA) with $21 target, citing stronger 2027–2028 earnings outlook driven by order pipeline and AI/cloud infrastructure opportunities.
: Nokia (NOKIA) struck a deal with BeeHealthy to embed Network as Code in its healthcare app: replacing SMS OTPs with network-based number verification and adding SIM swap, location and KYC APIs.
: Nokia (NOKIA) will supply networking tech for Bull’s LUMI-AI supercomputer, a €387.8M EuroHPC AI Factory project due H2 2027, installed at Finland’s LUMI centre.
